category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)

programs.name: Research and education programs
programs.focus: Northern Virginia's largest health system, with clinical and translational research including Inova Children's Hospital.
programs.notes: About 35 minutes from Leesburg, so no housing cost. You already worked in Fairfax at Privia, so you know the area and may have a contact who can point you at the right person. This is a hub page: the summer research listings sit under research and education, and a direct email is likely to work better than a portal.

programs.name: Summer research programs
programs.focus: Medical school research across neuroscience and the Lombardi Comprehensive Cancer Center.
programs.notes: Roughly an hour from Leesburg. Lombardi is an NCI comprehensive cancer center, and the neuroscience department is strong. Hub page: look under education and training for the summer listings.

programs.name: Research opportunities
programs.org: George Washington University School of Medicine
programs.focus: Clinical and translational research in downtown DC, with ties to Children's National.
programs.notes: GW's pediatrics department is based at Children's National, so an email here can lead to the same place by another route.

programs.name: Summer research programs
programs.focus: Biomedical research at a historically Black medical school, and one of the fourteen Amgen Scholars host sites.
programs.notes: Worth knowing: Howard is an Amgen Scholars host, so the Amgen application you are already writing can be pointed here, at a campus an hour from home. Amgen covers housing anyway, but the option to commute is there.

programs.name: Summer research
programs.org: Fralin Biomedical Research Institute at Virginia Tech Carilion
programs.focus: Neuroscience-heavy institute with work on addiction, developmental neuroscience and human neuroimaging.
programs.notes: Not commutable from Leesburg, but a genuinely strong neuroscience institute in Virginia that very few people outside the state apply to. The human neuroimaging work is close to what you already do in the lab.

programs.name: Summer research programs
programs.org: University of Virginia School of Medicine
programs.focus: Biomedical research at Virginia's flagship medical school, including UVA Children's.
programs.notes: About two hours from Leesburg, so a weekend drive home rather than a commute. In-state and a strong pediatrics department.
